# Crop Video

- Route: `/tools/crop-video`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `crop-video`

## Summary

Cut away the edges of a video — change the framing or aspect ratio without an editor. (Video tools)

## Details

Cropping removes the outer edges of a video — useful for reframing a shot, cutting out black bars or a watermark, or changing the aspect ratio for a platform. The Media Manipulator video cropper takes a pixel rectangle (where to start and how big) and exports just that area as a clean MP4.
### What it does
- Crops a video to a rectangle you specify in pixels.
- Removes black bars, edges, watermarks, or unwanted regions.
- Helps reframe to square or vertical for social platforms.
- Exports MP4 (H.264 + AAC) by default.
### How to use it
1. Upload your video: MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI or M4V to crop.
2. Enter the crop rectangle: Set the X/Y offset and the width/height to keep.
3. Crop: FFmpeg crops to exactly that region and re-encodes.
4. Download: Save the cropped video.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, avi, m4v
- Output: mp4, webm, mov, mkv
- Cropping re-encodes; MP4 output uses H.264 + AAC + yuv420p + faststart.
### Technical details
- Crop coordinates are in pixels from the top-left corner: X/Y is where the kept area starts, width/height is its size.
- Cropping re-encodes the video; MP4 output uses H.264 + AAC + yuv420p + faststart.
- For pixel-perfect framing on a preview, the full converter on the homepage offers a visual crop overlay.
### Use cases
- Make it vertical: Crop a landscape clip to 9:16 for Reels/Shorts/TikTok.
- Remove black bars: Crop away letterboxing.
- Hide a watermark: Crop out a corner logo or timestamp.
- Reframe a subject: Tighten the shot on what matters.
### FAQ
Q: How do I crop a video?
A: Upload it, enter the rectangle to keep (X/Y offset and width/height in pixels), and download the cropped video.
Q: Can I crop to a square or vertical aspect ratio?
A: Yes — set the width and height to the ratio you want (e.g. equal values for square, taller than wide for 9:16).
Q: Will cropping lower the quality?
A: Cropping re-encodes, but at our default quality the loss is minimal.
Q: Can I crop out a watermark?
A: Yes, if the watermark is near an edge — crop the frame to exclude it.

## Routing

When to send a visitor here: Send visitors here when they want to cut away part of the picture: remove black bars, trim edges, crop out a watermark or corner, or reframe a clip to square or vertical for social media.
When to send them elsewhere: To change the resolution while keeping the whole picture use Resize Video (resize-video). Sideways or upside-down footage belongs in Rotate Video (rotate-video), and still images go to Crop Image (crop-image).
Related tools: resize-video (scale after cropping); rotate-video (fix orientation); compress-video (shrink the result); crop-image (crop a photo instead)
